name: gizza-ai/aes-key-wrap
summary: Wrap or unwrap cryptographic keys with AES Key Wrap (RFC 3394 / RFC 5649)

tool.description: Wrap or unwrap cryptographic key material with the AES Key Wrap algorithm. operation = wrap (default) or unwrap. algorithm = kw (RFC 3394 / NIST SP 800-38F) or kwp (RFC 5649, with padding). The key (KEK) length selects AES-128/192/256 (16/24/32 bytes). data, key and wrapped output are hex or base64 (set format; default base64).
